verdict.rationale: Mistral publishes dedicated per-model cards and a List/Retrieve Models API, and its Known Limitations page refers to each model's context window (oversized requests return 400). None of the evidence shows actual numeric context-window, input or output token limits for any model. Missing for 10: explicit per-model context-window figures, separate input/output token limits, evidence that the model cards or the /v1/models response expose these values, and independent corroboration.
